Container.Overview: [b][span style='color: #E2211C;']⚠️ CRITICAL INSTALL STEPS:[/span][/b][br][br] 1. [b]User Script Required:[/b] You MUST run a script to set your mount point to 'shared'. [url=https://github.com/YourRepo/README.md]See README for script code.[/url][br] 2. [b]Mount Mode:[/b] Set your /library path to [b]RW: Slave[/b] in the path settings.[br] 3. [b]Secrets:[/b] Generate your secure keys at [url=https://riven.tv/generator]riven.tv/generator[/url].

Config.Name: Path: /library
Config.Description: MANDATORY: Set this to RW: Slave. This is the virtual folder where your debrid files appear.

Config.Name: Path: /riven/data
Config.Description: Persistent metadata and DB storage. Use an NVMe disk for best performance.

Config.Name: RIVEN_API_KEY
Config.Description: Secure 32-character key. Must match Frontend API key.
